name: macOS ARM PyInstaller

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-macos-arm:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
        run: |
          brew install python@3.11
          # Install common dependencies often required by PyInstaller builds on macOS
          # Adjust based on specific requirements in pyinstaller.sh or sshpilot.spec
          brew install pkg-config
          # If the app uses GTK or other GUI libs, they would be installed here
          # e.g., brew install gtk+3

      - name: Create Virtual Environment
        run: |
          python -m venv venv
          source venv/bin/activate
          pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

      - name: Install Project Dependencies
        run: |
          source venv/bin/activate
          # Install project dependencies
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
            pip install -r requirements.txt
          elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
            pip install .
          fi
          # Install PyInstaller
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Run PyInstaller Build
        run: |
          source venv/bin/activate
          # Run the existing build script
          chmod +x pyinstaller.sh
          ./pyinstaller.sh

      - name: Generate Checksums
        run: |
          # Find the generated DMG and App bundle
          DMG_FILE=$(find dist -name "*.dmg" -type f | head -n 1)
          APP_FILE=$(find dist -name "*.app" -type d | head -n 1)
          
          if [ -n "$DMG_FILE" ]; then
            shasum -a 256 "$DMG_FILE" > checksums.sha256
          fi
          
          if [ -n "$APP_FILE" ]; then
            # Compress the app bundle
            tar -czf "dist/SSHPilot.app.tar.gz" -C "$(dirname "$APP_FILE")" "$(basename "$APP_FILE")"
            shasum -a 256 "dist/SSHPilot.app.tar.gz" >> checksums.sha256
          fi

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: macos-arm-builds
          path: |
            dist/*.dmg
            dist/*.tar.gz
            checksums.sha256
          retention-days: 5
